questions.question: In Isaiah's message against Babylon, an uproar is heard on the mountains and among the kingdoms. What is happening?

answers.text: The LORD of Hosts is raising an army

questions.question: In Isaiah's message against Babylon, people are told to wail. What reason does Isaiah give?

answers.text: The Day of the LORD is near
The king of Babylon has died
